document.about: Panasonic FP series programmable controller digest (28 pages). Page 28 sets five dimension drawings, drawn with artwork past the page's edge and a background larger than the page.

notes: #116/#117: the page's shapes were measured unclipped, and one background larger than the page joined every shape into a group too large to be a drawing. The page had no region: its dimension labels were paragraphs, list items and tables.

checks.issue: The hole callout `4-M4 M0.16` was read as body text (an h1, before #140).
